title: EuchreGame
whatItDoes: Playable trick-taking card game running entirely client-side, with an optional on-device LLM opponent.
whatIsWasm: The deterministic card engine (`euchre_game` package) runs in the browser via Pyodide.
whatIsNotWasm: The LLM uses MediaPipe GenAI (LiteRT) with a user-supplied Gemma model running on WebGPU (WebLLM is legacy; repo README is stale). The 26 MB `genai_wasm_internal.wasm` acts as runtime glue.
whyWasmInferred: The exact same Python game engine is imported by `tests/test_game.py` and the browser bridge (`game_bridge.py`), ensuring bug-for-bug test parity without porting rules to JavaScript.
alternativeConsidered: A Python backend (introducing latency, hosting cost, and server ops) or a JS port (maintaining two identical rule engines in tandem).

footprint.method: Measured with wc -c and gzip -9 on vendored assets. User-supplied Gemma model required for LLM opponent.

networkNote: Pyodide runtime vendored locally in repository; no CDN dependency at load time. Local Gemma model loaded from user disk.

title: P2P Tic-Tac-Toe
whatItDoes: Serverless peer-to-peer multiplayer Tic-Tac-Toe with local relational game persistence and zero telemetry.
whatIsWasm: Compiled SQLite engine (sql.js) running inside a background Web Worker for relational querying and transaction logging.
whatIsNotWasm: Peer connectivity uses standard browser WebRTC DataChannels. Signalling is completely manual via SDP compressed into '#z' hash links or QR codes (no STUN/TURN, no signalling server).
whyWasmInferred: Full SQL query engine and relational integrity in the browser without server databases or complex IndexedDB schema code.
alternativeConsidered: IndexedDB (key-value schema without native SQL query engine) or server-hosted database like PostgreSQL/Firebase.

footprint.method: Measured with wc -c and gzip -9 on vendored sql.js. Note: Entire DB is re-exported to OPFS file on persist; does not use SQLite OPFS VFS.

networkNote: Zero network requests for database engine (vendored). Zero external signalling servers.

title: LunarLander Policy Lab
whatItDoes: Interactive reinforcement learning policy lab simulating OpenAI Gym LunarLander with live neural network agent evaluation.
whatIsWasm: Both the physics simulation (PyPyBox2D pure Python via micropip under Pyodide) and neural network inference (ONNX Runtime Web with executionProviders:['wasm']). WASM CPU only, no WebGPU.
whatIsNotWasm: Canvas rendering, chart orchestration, and telemetry UI implemented in vanilla modern JavaScript.
whyWasmInferred: Run authentic Gymnasium Python environment and 9 trained ONNX policy networks entirely client-side without backend compute.
alternativeConsidered: Server-side Python inference stream (expensive GPU/CPU compute bills) or porting Box2D/PPO agent directly to JS.

footprint.method: Measured with wc -c and gzip -9 against jsDelivr CDN assets. PPO model fetched from Hugging Face at build time.

networkNote: Loads Pyodide 0.23.4 and ONNX Runtime Web 1.19.2 from jsDelivr CDN at runtime.

title: Northstar RAG POC
whatItDoes: Private on-device Retrieval-Augmented Generation demo performing vector embedding, semantic search, and local LLM synthesis.
whatIsWasm: Text feature extraction and vector embedding generation run on WASM CPU (Transformers.js @ 3.0.2 onnx.wasm with numThreads=1 in a Web Worker).
whatIsNotWasm: Autoregressive LLM generation runs via @mlc-ai/web-llm on WebGPU (Llama-3.2-1B, ~880 MB). Falls back to retrieval-only mode if WebGPU is unavailable.
whyWasmInferred: Run embeddings and vector search in-browser without sending user documents or queries to third-party cloud embedding APIs.
alternativeConsidered: Cloud embedding APIs (OpenAI/Voyage) or compiling native Rust vector indexes to WASM.

footprint.raw: ONNX Runtime Web WASM (~11 MB raw) + Quantized embedding model weights + ~880 MB WebGPU Llama weights
footprint.gzip: ~2.9 MB ORT WASM gzip -9; models downloaded dynamically
footprint.method: Embedding worker confirmed WASM default in Transformers.js 3.0.2. Vector search under 2ms over 367 chunks reported in README.

networkNote: Hugging Face model weights and runtime dependencies downloaded on initial run via browser cache.

title: Age of Mycology
whatItDoes: Atmospheric biological strategy/fungal survival game built with Pygame and compiled directly to WebAssembly.
whatIsWasm: The entire Pygame game loop, entity component tree, logic, and rendering engine compiled via Pygbag (Note: Pygbag is distinct from Pyodide).
whatIsNotWasm: Browser HTML shell and canvas mounting container produced by Pygbag CI toolchain.
whyWasmInferred: Preserves core Python/Pygame codebase for web distribution without rewriting the entire simulation in Phaser or PixiJS.
alternativeConsidered: Rebuilding game in pure WebGL/JavaScript engine or requiring users to install native desktop Python packages.

footprint.raw: aom.tar.gz bundle ~63 MB with atlas profile (optimized down from ~143 MB; GitHub Actions CI ceiling is 75 MB)
footprint.method: Documented in aom repository CI workflow (.github/workflows/pages.yml).

networkNote: Game bundle loaded as single archive from static GitHub Pages host.

title: Lokarta
whatItDoes: Web-accessible terminal sandbox and spatial simulation running interactive Python sessions directly in the browser.
whatIsWasm: Full Python 3 environment running inside Pyodide, executing user simulation logic with persistent storage via Emscripten IDBFS.
whatIsNotWasm: xterm.js terminal UI and web container event handling in client JavaScript.
whyWasmInferred: Instant sandboxed execution of interactive Python tools with state persistence and zero backend attack surface.
alternativeConsidered: Server-side containerized Python sandboxes (Docker/nsjail) with significant recurring VPS infrastructure and security exposure.

footprint.method: Standard Pyodide 0.29.2 footprint delivered via jsDelivr CDN.

networkNote: Pyodide runtime and packages fetched on first load from CDN; file system state saved to browser IndexedDB via IDBFS.

title: Closed-System Speech POC
whatItDoes: Proof-of-concept for offline speech waveform reconstruction ('hello' / 'goodbye') using lightweight distilled neural models.
whatIsWasm: LiteRT (TensorFlow Lite runtime) compiled to WASM (`accelerator: 'wasm'`), executing small TFLite quantized models.
whatIsNotWasm: Audio Web Audio API context management, waveform canvas visualizer, and UI controls.
whyWasmInferred: Evaluate tiny neural audio models with zero server roundtrips, strict local privacy, and low latency.
alternativeConsidered: Web Audio DSP filters (harder to express learned representations) or server-based speech synthesis.

footprint.method: Measured with wc -c and gzip -9 on vendored litertjs WASM artifacts.

networkNote: Vendored runtime and local TFLite models; no external runtime network dependencies.

title: Vibe Tic-Tac-Toe (Non-WASM Control)
whatItDoes: Clean, instantaneous single-device Tic-Tac-Toe with local score tracking and theme selection.
whatIsWasm: None. Included deliberately as the control baseline in the 'Tic-Tac-Toe Trilogy' demonstrating when WebAssembly is completely unnecessary.
whatIsNotWasm: Entire application: 1 HTML file, 1 CSS stylesheet, 1 vanilla JavaScript script, and native browser localStorage.
whyWasmInferred: WebAssembly was NOT chosen because the problem domain does not require heavy compute, pre-existing native libraries, or complex SQL engines.
alternativeConsidered: Over-engineering with sql.js, Pyodide, or React. Rejected in favor of maximum simplicity and zero cold-start penalty.

footprint.raw: < 15 KB total codebase (HTML + CSS + JS combined)
footprint.method: Direct inspection of repository assets. Instant 0 ms startup.

networkNote: Zero runtime external calls, zero WASM payloads, instant first-contentful paint.
